content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Sure, what would you like to order?
I would like to order two chicken biryanis for delivery, and could you let me know if you have raita as well? Also, could you please make them less spicy if possible?
Sorry, chicken biryani is sold out today. Would you like to order prawn biryani instead?
No seafood for me, thank you. Could I have two chicken karahis instead?
Sorry, chicken karahi is also sold out today. Would you like to order prawn biryani instead?
No, we cannot have seafood. Do you have chicken pulao available?
Sorry, chicken pulao is also sold out today. Would you like to order prawn biryani instead?
No thank you, I cannot have seafood. What else do you have in chicken?
We currently don’t have any other chicken dishes available today. Would you like to order prawn biryani instead?

arguments.reason: No acceptable dishes available within brief constraints
